name: Loan-Back and Round-Tripping
description: Schemes in which criminals lend their own illicit funds to themselves or their entities through apparently legitimate loans, or send funds abroad and return them as investment, loans or trade receipts. Documentation creates a credible-looking origin for the money.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering Typologies: loan-back schemes (general)
FATF and Egmont Group, Concealment of Beneficial Ownership (2018)
JMLSG Guidance, lending and sector guidance (general)

indicators.name: Loan funded by related offshore party and repaid early
indicators.canon: Loan funded by related offshore party and repaid early
indicators.desc: Borrower receives loan from an entity linked to themselves and repays rapidly.
indicators.ctx: Borrower receives loan from an entity linked to themselves and repays rapidly.

indicators.name: Loan secured on assets or deposits from third parties of unclear origin
indicators.canon: Loan secured on assets or deposits from third parties of unclear origin
indicators.desc: Collateral is cash deposit or asset funded by unknown source.
indicators.ctx: Collateral is cash deposit or asset funded by unknown source.

indicators.name: Funds return from offshore as foreign investment
indicators.canon: Funds return from offshore as foreign investment
indicators.desc: Money sent abroad reappears as shareholder investment or loan.
indicators.ctx: Money sent abroad reappears as shareholder investment or loan.

indicators.name: Loan with no commercial purpose or unusual terms
indicators.canon: Loan with no commercial purpose or unusual terms
indicators.desc: Interest-free, no repayments, or terms inconsistent with market.
indicators.ctx: Interest-free, no repayments, or terms inconsistent with market.

indicators.name: Inconsistent loan documentation or backdated agreements
indicators.canon: Inconsistent loan documentation or backdated agreements

indicators.name: Borrower repays from unrelated third-party sources
indicators.canon: Payments from or to unrelated third parties
indicators.desc: Funds are paid or received, or instructions are given to pay, through parties with no evident link to the customer, contract, debt or insured interest. Includes third-party cheques, loan repayments, premiums, gaming funds and goods payments not matching the documentation.

indicators.name: Customer indifferent to cost of credit
indicators.canon: Customer indifferent to cost, return or value
indicators.desc: Customer readily accepts poor terms, fees, losses, penalties or prices, showing little interest in performance, provenance or negotiation.

indicators.name: Circular trade or invoices among connected entities
indicators.canon: Circular trade or invoices among connected entities
indicators.desc: Invoices cycled among related firms, returning funds to origin.
indicators.ctx: Invoices cycled among related firms, returning funds to origin.
